claims.summary: The localhost browser canary contains no whole-response arrayBuffer download and delegates bounded install, cache verification, activation, and deactivation to the registry lifecycle coordinator.

Cache reuse re-hashes the original manifest bytes, compares the parsed record, validates file identity, sizes, storage keys, and digests, and skips adapter transfer only when the exact cached install remains valid.

A different trusted manifest cannot replace the installed bytes under an adapter ID reported active; the attempt fails before any replacement file is requested and leaves the record and activation state unchanged.

Base-only state requires exact rollback proof; failed clearing or output restoration enters recovery-required with unknown native state and blocks generation and another load until unload plus fresh pinned-base reload succeeds.

The result is bounded to adversarial lifecycle software evidence plus retained mechanical smoke identity and creates no real-device recovery run, production adapter, quality win, held-out result, paid-reference parity, completed B/A judgment, or human validation; public Scion remains base-only.
